<Picture 1> is the EXACT starting key frame at 0.00 seconds. The video must begin pixel-consistently with <Picture 1> for scene composition: interior of a Hendry optical store, warm ambient store lighting, wooden display cabinets with glass tops, rows of eyeglass frames on illuminated shelves, mirrors on walls, professional yet cozy retail atmosphere. The opening frame must not be reinterpreted, redesigned, or changed into a different scene. Do not lock in the source-image pose as mandatory action for the video sequence.
<Picture 2> is the global character design reference, used throughout the video to lock the adult young woman's facial identity, hairstyle, eye color, body proportions, and elegant professional style.
<Audio 1> is a reference audio for voice timbre, vocal identity, speaking tone, rhythm, intonation, and lip-sync pacing.

[Shot 1] 10-second continuous cinematic commercial shot, 16:9 landscape. Begin with the exact visual world shown in <Picture 1>: interior of Hendry optical store, warm amber lighting, glass display cases, neatly arranged eyeglass frames, mirrors, and refined retail ambiance. The character is within this environment, stands gracefully facing the camera, holds up a pair of stylish eyeglasses, and begins speaking.

The camera pushes in with very slow and small amplitude toward her face and the glasses she is presenting. Warm store light from the upper front and side creates soft highlights across her eyes, cheeks, hair, fingers, and the glasses' frames and lenses. Subtle reflections dance on the glass display cases behind her. Fine dust particles float gently in the warm light; loose hair strands and her professional attire move delicately with her natural gestures.

She looks directly into the lens and says in natural Mandarin: <d>[Mandarin Chinese]欢迎来到亨德利眼镜，今天给大家推荐这款轻奢防蓝光眼镜，时尚百搭，有效呵护您的双眼，适合日常通勤和阅读使用。</d>

Use <Audio 1> to match the adult young woman's voice quality, warm professional tone, slightly breathy delivery, moderately fast Mandarin speaking rhythm, and expressive intonation. Her lip-sync must be accurate and synchronized to every syllable.

After she finishes speaking, she gently tilts the glasses toward the camera, showing the frame details and lenses, then smiles warmly at the lens. Her hair and clothing flow naturally with her movements.

Throughout the video, globally reference <Picture 2> to keep the same character identity, hairstyle, eye color, body proportions, and elegant professional style. Preserve ambient store sound, subtle fabric movement, gentle glass and frame handling sounds, and a refined commercial atmosphere. Add light hand movement sound and natural clothing rustle when she handles the glasses.

No subtitles, logos, watermarks, or text. Prevent identity drift, facial distortion, lip-sync delay, extra fingers, wrong hand poses, floating body, clothing deformation, hair color change, eye color change, background warping, and any change to the original Hendry optical store interior environment.
